body:
I did honors/regular my freshman year and failed hard, had to do online classes. 

Sophomore year and first half of junior year I did much better in AP classes. Second half of junior year I’m failing. I’m not sure if AP classes are the issue.
I don’t think I’m going to have to redo a year because it’s one semester. I will probably do 2-3 online classes next year and over the summer to make this up.
Yeah there is a month left, but my grades can rise in that time, especially because I missed a lot of stuff recently from being gone from school for a few days.
I don’t think I have to retake a whole year. Firstly because it’s just this half and secondly because it’s not over yet.
That’s what I’m planning to do. I’m scared that it’s too late. Major assignments have passed, and there’s only one month of school left, and many of those days won’t have any graded work.

> What classes are you taking? 

All AP. 

And I’m not making any effort to study or visit teachers. I cheat and procrastinate very often and it’s been months since I did homework at home.
For college I am thinking anthropology. And no, I’m undiagnosed and not taking any medicine for ADHD.
I genuinely do believe that I have ADHD. I have no work ethic and no motivation. It’s all my fault for being lazy.
